items.name: infinite-scroll
items.title: Infinite Scroll
items.description: Seamless infinite fullscreen scroll with parallax image effects, powered by Lenis smooth scrolling and GSAP scrub animations.

items.name: roughly
items.title: Roughly
items.description: Organic, hand-drawn vector annotations designed for high-friction digital typography. Wobbly underlines, pen circles, editorial strikethroughs, curly brackets, and tactile highlights.

items.name: image-reveal
items.title: Image Reveal
items.description: Multi-layered scroll-driven image stack reveal with analog flash exposure & SVG grain texture overlays.

items.name: image-parallax
items.title: Image Parallax
items.description: A smooth mouse-move and scroll-driven parallax image perspective effect.

items.name: living-text
items.title: Living Text
items.description: Stretches, rotates, and pushes characters dynamically based on real-time cursor proximity.

items.name: spotlight-text
items.title: Spotlight Text
items.description: Debossed display text with a cursor-following spotlight clipped to glyph shapes and a minimal glowing bulb on the dot of 'i' and 'j'.

items.name: gravity-card-stack
items.title: Gravity Card Stack
items.description: Falling rigid body physics cards container that reacts to scroll triggers.

items.name: coverflow-carousel
items.title: Coverflow Carousel
items.description: A hardware-accelerated 3D coverflow carousel with continuous modular perspective transforms and comprehensive gesture tracking.

items.name: void-button
items.title: Void Button
items.description: Pure black button that reveals a luxury gold gradient under the cursor via a smooth radial mask.

items.name: brushed-titanium-button
items.title: Brushed Titanium Button
items.description: Machined titanium texture with anisotropic highlight sweeps and reactive spotlight illumination.

items.name: liquid-gold-button
items.title: Liquid Gold Button
items.description: Conic gradient rotating behind a frosted glass blur layer, with a 1px border that catches light only at the top.

items.name: guilloche-button
items.title: Guilloche Button
items.description: Watch dial Guilloché patterns generating Moire wave shapes under the cursor spotlight.

items.name: button-alpha
items.title: Button Alpha
items.description: High-friction matte polymer button with fine light-catching bevel borders and heavy Z-axis mechanical compression.

items.name: pixel-melt
items.title: Pixel Melt
items.description: A full-viewport pixel grid that glows and cools under cursor heat, leaving behind a slow melt trail.

items.name: breathing-grid
items.title: Breathing Grid
items.description: An orthogonal grid with a slow left-to-right traveling wave, with local brightness boost near the cursor.

items.name: breathing-background
items.title: Breathing Background
items.description: An atmospheric sweeping pattern background with breathing backlight glow, vignette layer, and dynamic pattern options (diagonal, stripes, dots, grid).

items.name: floating-embers
items.title: Floating Embers
items.description: Glowing ember particles that float upward with a gentle sway, reacting subtly to cursor and scroll.

items.name: horizon-glow
items.title: Horizon Glow
items.description: A glow rising off the bottom edge and fading out as it climbs, with film grain and a subtle cursor parallax. Two moods: soft drifting colour blobs, or a very slow audio-visualizer of heavily blurred columns rising and settling into one glowing skyline.

items.name: spotlight-grid
items.title: Spotlight Grid
items.description: A dark grid with decorative tech icons and a dual-layer mouse-following spotlight effect using screen and color-dodge blend modes.

items.name: lumina-wave
items.title: Lumina Wave
items.description: An atmospheric WebGL background rendering undulating wave patterns resembling an aurora, featuring interactive mouse-bending and color personalization.

items.name: matrix-rain
items.title: Matrix Rain
items.description: A canvas-driven digital rain simulation displaying streaming glowing characters and icons in a premium monochrome aesthetic.

items.name: anisotropic-knob
items.title: Anisotropic Knob
items.description: Machined metal rotary dial knob component with dynamic rotating anisotropic highlights, snapper increments, and accessibility controls.

items.name: laser-vault-password
items.title: Vault
items.description: Passcode vault keypad with laser-etch cooling characters, dynamic cursor sweeps, tactile clicks, container rattles, and friction-metal creak alarms.

items.name: premium-hero
items.title: Premium Hero
items.description: Interactive Hero Section featuring floating 3D cards, typewriter search, spring CTA, and paper-notebook grid aesthetics.

items.name: dot-matrix
items.title: Dot Matrix
items.description: Highly optimized, programmable LED dot matrix display supporting Perlin noise, typewriter bitmaps, Web Audio integration, interactive cursor repelling, and custom plugin architectures.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A vertical dynamic scrollbar overlay with interactive tick mark animations, dragging controls, and velocity-based stretching/glow.

items.name: ruler-scrollbar
items.title: Ruler Scrollbar
items.description: A minimal ruler-style scrollbar on the right edge. Ticks near the current scroll position softly brighten and widen as you move down the page.

items.name: scroll-water
items.title: Scroll Water
items.description: A floating back-to-top button that fills with water as you read. Two waves drift inside the circle while the level rises with scroll progress, and an up-arrow surfaces once the page is fully read.

items.name: choice
items.title: Choice
items.description: One control for checkboxes and radios. Unchecked, it's a socket cut into the surface; checked, the box rises out of it, or a pearl rises in the middle. ChoiceGroup holds the value; the card variant lifts the chosen option and lights its edge.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: A window of content on the native <dialog>: focus trap, Escape and focus return built in. A raised panel with a prismatic edge, a close socket, and actions in a darker footer tray.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A decision before carrying on: an alert dialog with a cancel and a confirm action. No backdrop dismiss, Escape cancels, and a promise from onConfirm holds it open with a spinner until it settles.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between panels of one view. The list is a well and the active tab is a raised segment that slides between tabs; the underline variant swaps it for a prismatic line, for page-level tabs. Arrow keys move and select, Home and End jump.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A small inline choice of two to five options in the Tabs material. Real radio inputs underneath, so arrow keys and forms work natively; the raised segment glides to whichever is checked. Labels, icons, or icons alone.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from the side on the native <dialog>, with focus trap, Escape and focus return built in. It floats just off the edge so the bevel, prismatic edge and long shadow all read; title, close socket and a footer tray for actions.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: Vertical navigation for sidebars and drawers. Groups, links or buttons with icons and badges, and collapsible sections on a machined rail. The current page is a raised segment that glides between items, even into a section.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A track cut into the surface with a popout fill rising out of it. Determinate progress slides the fill; leave the value out and a short slab sweeps across the well instead. Label and value above, real progressbar semantics underneath.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An input that filters a list as you type. The field is a well; the list opens on the browser's top layer so nothing can clip it, flips above the field when there's no room, and a raised highlight glides between rows.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A real <table> in a raised card: a darker header band, rows split by a machined cut line, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures, and sortable headers that report aria-sort. Optional title, action and footer tray.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Where you are, as a trail of quiet links: ancestors in tertiary text, separators set back further, the current page in primary. Long trails fold their middle into a small socket that opens in place.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The everyday button. Primary rises out of the surface as the lightest object on screen; secondary is a raised key; ghost appears on hover; danger carries a warning edge. Loading keeps the width; pass href for a real link.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: Input, textarea and field in one: a well with its label above and a hint or error below, all wired for screen readers. Leading and trailing slots, a show-password toggle, an auto-growing multiline mode and a quiet character count.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one value. The list unfolds out of the field: it opens with your choice sitting exactly on the field and widens from that line, then folds back into whatever you pick. Type-ahead, groups, press-drag-release, and a value that rolls when changed from the keyboard.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A well with the colour in a round socket; open it for a shade area cut into the panel, recessed hue and opacity tracks with rings that lift when held, a hex field, the screen eyedropper, and preset chips with a gliding ring.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover and Dropdown Menu on one floating panel: top layer so nothing clips it, flips at the edge, closes on Escape or a click outside. The menu adds a gliding raised highlight, arrow keys, type-ahead, submenus, radio and check items, groups and shortcuts.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page through a long list. Quiet ghost numbers with a raised current page that glides between them; the row keeps the same slots so nothing shifts. A compact "Page 5 of 20" variant rolls its number the way you moved.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A slim raised bar of menus — File, Edit, View. The open menu's trigger sinks into the bar and the sunken segment glides as you move between menus; hover or the arrow keys carry you across. Menus bring submenus, radio and check items, and shortcuts.

items.name: folder-reveal
items.title: Folder Reveal
items.description: A dark folder with a frosted-glass front. Hover it and the flap tips forward on its hinge while the sheets inside spring up one after another, overshooting a touch and fanning out like a hand of cards.

items.name: polaroid-stack
items.title: Polaroid Stack
items.description: A pile of polaroids fanned out on a table with handwritten captions. Hover a print and it steps sideways out of the pile; click it and it springs out onto the table. Only a few fit at once: pull one more and the oldest bounces back home. The drag variant lets you pick prints up and put them down anywhere instead.

items.name: activity-card
items.title: Activity Card
items.description: A daily activity summary on a raised card: metric rows with sleep and heart glyphs on the left, and concentric rings sweeping in from the corner around a popout score disc. Each ring runs in a sunken track, its fill brightening toward the disc, with a value pearl at its end.

items.name: ruler-nav
items.title: Ruler Nav
items.description: The presentation-mode navigator as a component: a grouped list hung off a ruler of hairline ticks. The row under the pointer stretches its tick and springs its label right, leaving a soft settling trail. Search with highlighted matches, folding groups, badges, and full keyboard control.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A faint ring cut into the surface with a quarter arc running round it, trailed by a softer half-arc so the turn reads as motion. Takes its colour from the text around it, so it works on popout and raised surfaces alike.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A dashed well you drop files into or click to browse, with a real file input underneath so forms and keyboards just work. Files list below in trays with a thumbnail, size and a slim progress bar; rejected files stay with the reason.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Mount one <Toaster /> and call toast() from anywhere. Small raised cards with a status dot, optional action, promise support, a stack that fans out on hover, timers that pause while you look, and swipe to dismiss.

items.name: moon-pull
items.title: Moon Pull
items.description: A golden disc hanging on a strand of yarn. Pull it down and the cord stretches, resists and glows, then clicks like a lamp pull, springs back and fires onPull.

items.name: stacked-cards
items.title: Stacked Cards
items.description: A loose pile of paper prints that deals out into a masonry collage, one sheet after another, and gathers back from a sticky button. The collage is always laid out; the pile is just transforms on top.

items.name: tilted-collage
items.title: Tilted Collage
items.description: A masonry wall of uncropped images on white paper mounts, each at a slight angle and drop. Wide strips break out of the columns and run across the whole wall.

items.name: taped-marquee
items.title: Taped Marquee
items.description: An endless row of photos mounted on paper and held down with torn tape, drifting sideways like pages pinned along a line. Pure CSS: pauses on hover, scrolls by hand under reduced motion.

items.name: now-playing-card
items.title: Now Playing Card
items.description: A Spotify-style vinyl player card powered by Last.fm API that dynamically retrieves real-time listening history with vinyl spin animations.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: A drum of values in 3D: drag it, flick it, scroll it, tap a row or use the keys, and it settles on a value in a recessed slot with a soft detent tick. Text tone follows the drum directly, so it never blurs or re-renders mid-spin.

items.name: weapon-wheel
items.title: Weapon Wheel
items.description: Premium GTA V-inspired selection wheel designed for development tools, featuring interactive SVG slices, Tabler icons, mechanical clicks, and live stats dashboards.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero Landing
items.description: Highly configurable, responsive portfolio hero landing page with technical grids and interactive pixel art decorations.

items.name: expand-on-hover
items.title: Expand On Hover
items.description: A stack of compact preview cards that smoothly expand into immersive content panels on hover, featuring physical parting animations and 3D pointer tracking.

items.name: text-shuffle
items.title: Text Shuffle
items.description: A text animation component that shuffles characters with multiple variants including cipher, scramble, and typewriter effects.

items.name: cards
items.title: Cards
items.description: A fanned deck of dark editorial cards with B&W images, prismatic top-border highlights, spring-physics animations, and an expand-on-click description reveal.

items.name: simple-card
items.title: Simple Card
items.description: A single dark editorial card with a padded B&W image, prismatic top-border highlight, Instrument Serif title pinned to the bottom, and an expand-on-click description reveal.

items.name: flickering-grid-playground
items.title: Flickering Grid Playground
items.description: An interactive cockpit controller playground for experimenting with grid sizing, gaps, flicker chance, and curated presets.

items.name: dot-pattern-playground
items.title: Dot Pattern Playground
items.description: An interactive cockpit controller playground for dynamic dot sizes, gaps, custom swatches, and interactive spotlight masking.

items.name: animated-icons-1
items.title: Animated Icons 1
items.description: Nine Tabler icons in small monochrome black cards. Click any card to fire its unique animation — triple spin, nuclear collapse, hex facet snap, supernova burst, lemniscate shudder, glitch disintegrate, lightning strike, helix flip, or vortex implosion. Pure monochrome, no color, no shadows.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite scrolling marquee section utilizing custom edit-dashed cards and compact icon tiles with speed, direction, and corner blur settings.

items.name: marquee-2
items.title: Marquee 2
items.description: An infinite curved path marquee section animating official colored brand icons along a custom bezier SVG path.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open in place. Switching is one movement: one section folds as the next opens; the open card lifts a touch, its chevron socket sinks, and the content settles in a beat behind. Separated cards or one joined card; full keyboard support.

items.name: chat-faq
items.title: Chat FAQ
items.description: An FAQ that reads like a conversation. Questions are raised pills; ask one and it rises out of the stack, and the answer arrives as a reply bubble: a beat of typing dots, then the words stream in while the bubble grows to hold them. One answer at a time by default, full keyboard support, and screen readers get the whole answer at once.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: The scrolling thread a chat lives in. It holds on to the bottom while a reply streams, lets go when you scroll up to read, and offers a raised key to glide back down. A native log region: set busy while streaming and screen readers announce the finished reply, not every token.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn in a chat. A user message is a raised bubble with a curl off its corner; an assistant reply sits flat on the page beside an avatar socket. Status walks it from typing dots to streaming words to done, or to an error with Retry. Messages rise in and fade away.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: The chat composer: a deep well that grows a line at a time, with a tray for tools and a send key that rises out of its socket once there's something to send. While a reply is on its way the key becomes stop. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks a line; status matches the AI SDK's useChat.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Text that arrives a word at a time; each word settles and un-blurs as it lands. Feed it a growing string from a model stream, or the finished text with reveal and it plays itself. A caret blinks while it's live.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: Shows the assistant is working before any words arrive: three dots breathing in turn, or a label with a band of light passing across it.

items.name: chat-sidebar
items.title: Chat Sidebar
items.description: The history panel of a chat app: a New chat key, a search well, and threads grouped Pinned, Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days and on by month. The open thread is a raised segment that glides between rows. Each row's ⋯ key unfolds a menu (Share, Rename, Pin, Archive, Delete) that scales out of the key as its blur clears, with a gliding highlight and a small gesture on every icon. Icons by Hugeicons.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: A model's reply, rendered as it streams: headings, lists, quotes, tables, fenced code as a Code Block, and inline marks. Words come out on a steady beat and fade up out of a blur; half-finished bold or code is closed for you so nothing flickers. Built-in parser, no dependency.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code in a well, with a tray carrying the language and a copy key. Highlighting is monochrome, light and weight instead of hue, from a tiny built-in tokenizer. Optional line numbers; scrolls sideways instead of wrapping.

items.name: message-actions
items.title: Message Actions
items.description: The quiet row of keys under a reply: copy (turns into a tick), regenerate (gives its arrows a turn), good and bad. A rating sinks into a socket and stays there. Add your own keys with MessageAction.

items.name: prompt-suggestions
items.title: Prompt Suggestions
items.description: Starter prompts for an empty chat or a follow-up: a wrapping row of raised pills, or a grid of cards with an icon in a socket and a line of description. They rise in one after another.

items.name: sticker-card
items.title: Sticker Card
items.description: An interactive card that scatters bouncy physics-based stickers all over the viewport on hover.

items.name: datepicker
items.title: Datepicker
items.description: A skeuomorphic 3D beveled calendar date picker with synth mechanical click sound feedback.

items.name: navbar-1
items.title: NavBar1
items.description: A floating horizontal navigation panel console with sliding tabs, active status glows, and search well.

items.name: forgeui-landing
items.title: ForgeUI Landing
items.description: Sleek dark landing page hero section with radial spotlights, customizable calls to action, and interactive social/tech stack footer.

items.name: rays-landing
items.title: Rays Landing
items.description: Interactive portfolio landing page showcasing an overhead WebGL light-ray beam background, floating liquid-glass navigation, and role cycler.

items.name: chalkboard-404
items.title: Chalkboard 404
items.description: A 404 on a chalkboard set in a raised frame: the digits have fallen onto the chalk ledge and dashed chalk outlines show where they go. Drag the 4, 0 and 4 back (or press Enter on each) and an eraser wipes the slate white before sending you home.

items.name: polaroid-develop
items.title: Polaroid Develop
items.description: Polaroid prints scattered down a table that develop as you scroll: murky chemistry clears from the centre out, a cool cast warms into full colour, a sheen slides across, and the caption is written in ink stroke by stroke. Prints swing and lag with scroll speed and straighten on hover.

items.name: breathing-scale-card
items.title: Breathing Scale Card
items.description: An ambient scale card component featuring overshooting corner border lines, a soft vignette mask, breathing backlight glows, and sweeping geometric pattern animations.

items.name: github-heatmap
items.title: GitHub Heatmap
items.description: An ultra-polished GitHub contribution heatmap featuring live data fetching for @ajinkya-cell, streak stats, theme presets, interactive tooltips, and month focus filtering.

items.name: developer-id-card
items.title: Developer ID Card
items.description: An ultra-polished, feature-packed 3D Developer ID Card featuring GitHub profile image, live local clock, tech stack badges, social links, and 3D metallic presets.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app sidebar built from the primitives: a Drawer on the native <dialog> when it overlays the page, or the same raised panel docked inline. Nav inside, with collapsible sections and a current-page segment that glides between items; plan card and profile in a footer tray.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A ⌘K command palette on a native dialog: search set into a raised panel, results in a recessed tray, and a highlight that rises out of the tray and glides between rows.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Two switches in one: the original mechanical 3D rocker with its LED, and a machined variant from the design system, where the thumb rises into the light popout surface when on and stretches towards its travel as you press.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code field: a row of wells over a single real input, so SMS autofill, paste and screen readers just work. The active well takes the focus border, characters rise into place, masked PINs show as popout pearls, and error or success tint the edges with a message underneath.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Magnetic Hologram Tooltip featuring 3D parallax tracking with mouse cursor position, glowing neon border, and frosted glass backdrop blur.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Circuit Path Timeline featuring traveling laser light pulses along connecting circuit lines and illuminated 3D debossed milestone node checkpoints.

items.name: globe
items.title: Globe
items.description: A minimal monochrome 3D WebGL globe powered by cobe. Dark obsidian sphere with high-resolution world map sampling, atmospheric glow, and smooth drag rotation.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: A dark Bento Grid with Inter typography, unboxed brand icons, and beveled or radiant card variants.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: Minimalist precision sentiment meter & gauge with automatic mount sweep calibration, dynamic sentiment colors, and real-time synchronized numerical counter.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: An instrument card: a dial of machined segments around a recessed face. Segments between the origin and the value rise to popout, the leading one runs long as the needle, and the value sits in the face. Low, high and optimum work like the native <meter>, with a status chip in the header and a real meter underneath.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: A family of charts in the machined material: line, area, grouped and stacked bars, ranked horizontal bars, donut, radar, scatter, radial goal rings and sparklines. Plots are cut into the card as recessed trays, series are told apart by luminance and dash rather than hue, bars rise out of wells as popout parts, and a crosshair tooltip follows the pointer or arrow keys. Every chart carries its data as a hidden table for screen readers.

items.name: matrix-ripple-background
items.title: Matrix Ripple Background
items.description: A full-screen canvas of faint, slowly mutating characters. Clicking or tapping anywhere sends out a circular wave.

items.name: stacked-card-fan
items.title: Stacked Card Fan
items.description: Three SimpleCards held like a hand of cards that stay stacked until you scroll, then glide out smoothly with your scroll on spring physics.
